name: dnbg-comforts
description: Small conveniences for the session itself: /later notes that wait for Claude's next turn, a quiet usage band above the prompt, a heads-up when your saved model changes, and a copy of the transcript before each compaction. No forge, no workflow opinions.

standard_model.title: Your standard model
standard_model.description: The model you normally run, as an alias ('opus', 'sonnet') or part of a model id. The usage band flags any other model the session runs on, red when it costs more and blue when it costs less, and you are told when the model saved for future sessions changes to something else. Leave empty for 'opus'.

data_dir.title: Where dnbg keeps its files
data_dir.description: Directory the transcript copies sit under, as transcripts/<session id>/. Must be an absolute path or one under '~/', using only letters, digits and '. _ - /'; anything else is ignored and the default used instead. Leave empty for '~/.claude/dnbg'.
